faqs.question: Will this charger work with my laptop model?
faqs.answer: It fits Lenovo ThinkPad models that charge over USB-C — send us your laptop model on WhatsApp and we'll confirm before you order.

faqs.question: Is this an original or compatible charger?
faqs.answer: It's a new OEM-equivalent charger built to the same output spec as the original — stated clearly on this page.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with a charger?
faqs.answer: This charger carries a 6-month warranty from the date of purchase.
